lean.statement:
∀ {E : Type u_1}
  [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E] {f : E → ℝ} {β : ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ 1 f →
    ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ f →
      0 < β →
        (∀ (x y : E), f y ≤ f x + inner ℝ (gradient f x) (y - x) + β / 2 * ‖y - x‖ ^ 2) →
          ∀ (x y : E), ‖gradient f y - gradient f x‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * β * (f y - f x - inner ℝ (gradient f x) (y - x))
approved_definition_context: ContDiff ℝ 1 f means continuous Frechet differentiability on the entire space.
ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ f is the real convex chord inequality on the whole space.
gradient f x is the Riesz vector of the Frechet derivative: inner ℝ (gradient f x) v = fderiv ℝ f x v under the displayed differentiability.
NNReal is the type of nonnegative real numbers; LipschitzWith b g means dist (g x) (g y) <= (b:ℝ) * dist x y for every x,y.
